Name: Tiled Counter Kitchen Edit
Author: yuiidragon
Description:
[b]5/07/2016[/b]
[list]
[*][size=2]Added compatibility patch for[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/299/?] [color=#f6b26b]DevilBro's [/color][/url][color=#f6b26b][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/299/?][/url][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/299/?]Bathroom in Hou[/url]seupgrade2[/color] mod.[/size]
[/list][size=2]
[img]http://www.lousiestcrook.com/images/bluepagebreak.png[/img][/size]
[size=2] 
[/size][b]Installation:[/b]
1. Backup your default files.
2. Unzip the file.
3. Place the "farmouse_tiles.xnb" file into your Stardew Valley\Contentfolder, overwriting the old file.
If you're using Steam, the default folder path is something like C:\Program Files\Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\

[i]If you're using another mod that edits farmhouse_tiles.xnb, this will overwrite that mod. If you want to use both, let me know and I'll see what I can do.[/i]

[b]Uninstallation:[/b]
1. Delete the file.
2. Restore the backup you made.
[size=2]
[img]http://www.lousiestcrook.com/images/bluepagebreak.png[/img][/size]

[b]Compatibility Patches:[/b]
For these to work, please [b]install the other mod first[/b] then install my compatibility patch on top of it. It won't work otherwise.

[list=1]
[*][size=2]Patch for[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/299/?] Bathroom in Houseupgrade2[/url] by Devilbro[/size]
[/list][size=2]
[/size][b][size=2]If there's a mod you're using and you'd like for it to work with my mod, let me know and I'll make a patch for it. [/size][/b]
